## Summary

Describe the focused outcome and why it belongs in ntfsmac.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant Swift and/or shell tests pass
- [ ] Packaging or hardware checks completed when behavior requires them
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented state
- [ ] No credentials, build output, local evidence, personal paths, or private device data added

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] Privileged actions still use the XPC helper
- [ ] Mount truth and teardown remain fail-closed
- [ ] Persisted settings or installed-helper migrations are documented when changed
